subtitles.zh: 首先，克里斯蒂娜，我想用加拿大人友好的方式说，别显得刻薄。
subtitles.en: Okay, so first of all, Christina, and I want to say this in a nice Canadian way and not be a jerk.

subtitles.en: Look, I'm not privy to the inside details of the negotiation, and even if I were, it's not my place to reveal them.
